description: Source file implementing platform-specific functions for OpenThread on Zephyr OS, including reset, wake, and bootloader mode handling.

methods.name: otPlatReset
methods.description: Resets the platform; on Posix, triggers a warm reboot.

methods.name: otPlatResetToBootloader
methods.description: Attempts to reset device into bootloader mode, depending on configuration.

methods.name: otPlatGetResetReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for the last reset, here always power-on.

methods.name: otPlatWakeHost
methods.description: Placeholder for waking the host; currently does nothing.

methods.name: otPlatAssertFail
methods.description: Handles assertion failures by printing message and performing post-action.
